description: Baseline: default architecture with random init; prints the task object's public interface.
Random init; prints method signatures and sample examples drawn with a non-eval seed to learn the prompt format.
Word-anchored 4-char stem tokens; label from fraction of hypothesis content words found in the premise (exact stems only).
Stem overlap plus hand-written synonym concepts and hypernym closure (premise man unlocks hypothesis person).
Adds mutual-exclusion conflict: an unmatched hypothesis concept whose exclusive group appears in the premise votes contradiction.
Adds hypothesis-only cue-word votes per class (negations, purpose clauses, generic nouns) from known NLI annotation artefacts.
Lowers the contradiction overlap threshold from 0.35 to 0.25 to reduce neutral-to-contradiction errors; prints sample dev errors.
Adds a count of hypothesis words absent from the premise via uniform attention over fixed positions; each one penalises entailment.
Treats generic verbs, collectives and particles (wear, hold, look, group, near, up) as non-content so implied words stop counting as unmatched.
Broader synonym lexicon (photo, music, food, beverage, smile, work, ball) with vehicle and ball hypernyms; reports second-seed accuracy and dev/eval overlap.
Extends the char window to 7 to spot the word after is/are/was; an unmatched main verb votes contradiction.
Reduces the unmatched main-verb contradiction vote from 3.0 to 1.0 after the stronger weight over-predicted contradiction.
Removes the main-verb circuit (no dev gain) and raises the exclusive-group conflict weight from 4 to 6.
Adds a constant -1 bias on the neutral logit because neutral is over-predicted relative to its gold frequency.
Reduces the neutral logit bias to -0.3 after -1 lowered accuracy on both larger non-eval samples.
Expands neutral cue words with motives, plans, superlatives and occasions that annotators add without premise support.
Generalises the stem circuit to L chars and tests L=5 so fewer distinct words collide; match threshold follows as L-0.5.
Tests L=3 word stems at the aggressive end of stemming after L=5 lost accuracy on both larger samples.
Returns to L=4 stems and adds a neutral vote that grows with the number of hypothesis content words.
Each hypothesis word absent from the premise now also adds 0.4 to the contradiction logit, on top of penalising entailment.
Drops the length and new-word terms; attention tilted to the earliest hypothesis content word flags an unmatched subject.
Removes the subject circuit and lowers the contradiction cue-word vote from 5 to 3.
Halves the entailment cue-word vote from 3 to 1.5, since generic nouns like person may be weak evidence.
Raises the entailment cue-word vote to 4.5 after halving it clearly lost accuracy and entailment recall.
Restores the entailment vote to 3 and raises the matched-fraction gain from 8 to 12 relative to the cue votes.
Lowers the matched-fraction gain to 5 so the cue votes and conflict bit weigh more against word overlap.
Lowers the match threshold so a premise stem agreeing on 3 of 4 chars counts as matched (men/man, swim/swam); gain back to 8.
Relaxes the match threshold further so a premise stem agreeing on 2 of 4 chars counts as matched.
Returns to 3-of-4 soft matching and raises the entailment threshold to 0.7 because soft matching inflates the matched fraction.
Ablation of e27: removes the expanded neutral cue list to test whether a shorter lexicon keeps the same accuracy.
Ablation test: zeroes the unmatched-word penalty on entailment to measure what the count head contributes before removing it.
Restores the unmatched penalty and removes the sport and vehicle exclusive groups with their hypernyms to shrink the lexicon.
Restores sport and vehicle groups and adds exclusive instrument and activity groups, since conflict coverage has paid off.
Adds antonym groups for age, size, time of day, weather and counts; number words leave the stoplist so they can conflict.
Keeps the age, size, time and weather antonym groups but returns number words to the stoplist.
Drops antonym groups (no gain over e33) and adds a head that votes neutral when the premise names only a parent of a hypothesis concept.
Same circuit as e33 with every Linear and Embedding pruned to its nonzero rows and columns; must reproduce e33 exactly with far fewer parameters.
On the pruned e33 base, lowers the contradiction overlap threshold to 0.25 to reduce neutral predicted as contradiction.
Keeps the 0.3 contradiction threshold and lowers the per-word unmatched penalty on entailment from 1.5 to 1.0.
Raises the per-word unmatched penalty on entailment to 2.0 after 1.0 lost accuracy on both larger samples.
Lowers attention sharpness from 30 to 10 so partially matching premise stems give graded rather than all-or-nothing evidence.
Softens attention further to beta 5 to find where graded match evidence stops helping.
Returns to beta 10 and ablates the contradiction cue list down to negation words and sleeping.
Removes the photo, food, beverage, smile and work synonym concepts to test whether they earn their detectors.
Removes the exclusive color group to measure how much of the conflict signal depends on color words.
Restores the color group and halves the conflict weight to 3, matching the cue votes so all evidence uses one scale.
Restores conflict weight 6 and halves the neutral logit bias to -0.15.
Restores neutral bias -0.3 and cuts neutral cues to eight purpose and unsupported-detail words.
Restores the 20-word neutral list and removes human and instrument from the entailment cues.
Final cleaned model: same circuit as e49 with unused flags and redundant lines removed and the docstring brought up to date.
